title: "Analysis Script – Correlation, Factor Analysis, and ICC"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(correlation)
library(see)
library(psych)
library(irr)
library(rempsyc)
```

## Set Working Directory

```{r}
script_dir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)

## Define Day and Date
day <- 1

## Load Parameters and Preprocess
pilot_anal_folder <- paste0("../output/session", day)
params <- read.csv(paste0(pilot_anal_folder,"/df_", day, "_with_id.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
params$subjID <- sub("^output/", "", params$subjID)

#knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = paste0("../pilot analyses/", collection_date))

```

## Select Relevant Parameters

```{r}
reduced_params <- params %>%
  select(subjID, foraging_exit_threshold, rlwm_alpha, gng_beta, gng_eps, phys_k)
```

## Load and Merge Questionnaire Scores

```{r}
questionnaires <- read.csv(paste0(pilot_anal_folder, "/questionnaire_scores.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

params_questionnaires_df <- merge(params, questionnaires, by = "subjID", all.x = TRUE)
reduced_params_questionnaires_df <- merge(reduced_params, questionnaires, by = "subjID", all.x = TRUE)
```

## Correlation Matrices

```{r}
cor_matrix <- correlation(params_questionnaires_df, method = "spearman")
reduced_cor_matrix <- correlation(reduced_params_questionnaires_df, method = "spearman")

cor_matrix %>%
  summary(redundant = TRUE) %>%
  plot()

reduced_cor_matrix %>%
  summary(redundant = TRUE) %>%
  plot()
```

## Factor Analysis on Parameters

```{r}
reduced_param_fa_df <- reduced_params[, -1]

fa_params <- factanal(x = reduced_param_fa_df, factors = 2, rotation = "varimax", scores = "regression")
fa_params_scores <- fa_params$scores
```

## Correlate Factor Scores with Questionnaires

```{r}
fa_params_scores_df <- as.data.frame(fa_params_scores)
fa_params_scores_params_df <- cbind(reduced_params_questionnaires_df, fa_params_scores_df)

cor_fa_params_scores <- correlation(fa_params_scores_params_df, method = "spearman")

cor_fa_params_scores %>%
  summary(redundant = TRUE) %>%
  plot()
```

## Assess Reliability of Questionnaires (ICC)

```{r}
the_other_day <- 1

if (day == 1) {
  the_other_day <- 2
}

the_other_questionnaires <- read.csv(paste0(pilot_anal_folder, "/../session", the_other_day, "/questionnaire_scores.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

both_days_questionnaires <- merge(questionnaires, the_other_questionnaires, by = "subjID", suffixes = c("_day1", "_day2"))

questionnaire_vars <- c(
  "behavioral_activation",
  "emotional_sensitivity",
  "social_motivation",
  "Score_ASRM",
  "Score_CESD"
)

icc_results_list <- list()

for (var in questionnaire_vars) {
  day1_col <- paste0(var, "_day1")
  day2_col <- paste0(var, "_day2")
  
  icc_out <- icc(both_days_questionnaires[, c(day1_col, day2_col)], model = "twoway", type = "agreement", unit = "single")
  
  icc_results_list[[var]] <- data.frame(
    Questionnaire = var,
    ICC = icc_out$value,
    CI_Lower = icc_out$lbound,
    CI_Upper = icc_out$ubound
  )
}

icc_df <- do.call(rbind, icc_results_list)

print(icc_df)
```
